summary: The pricing call on 2026-03-17 included CFO Vikram Desai, VP Engineering Anjali Rao, CISO Farhan Sheikh, Head of Procurement Meera Kulkarni and AE Rahul. Vikram challenged the ₹42 L proposal versus Stratify’s ₹30 L quote, prompting Rahul to offer a 20% discount to about ₹33.6 L. Anjali highlighted product strengths and Sneha promised reconciliation monitors within a week. Rahul committed to send the SOC2 Type II report by 24 Mar and to email the revised quote to Meera the same day.

objections.text: Your proposal says forty-two lakh a year. Stratify quoted us thirty. Why is this worth twelve lakh more?

competitors.name: Stratify
competitors.context: CFO mentioned Stratify price and will show our number to them
